name: Achille Varzi
features: pale skin, black hair slicked back, dark hooded eyes, thin elegant face, immaculate grooming, slender build, cold impassive expression
bio: Nuvolari's great rival and his exact opposite: ice-cold, mathematically smooth, never seen with a crease in his overalls. Varzi won the Targa Florio, the Mille Miglia and the 1934 Italian Grand Prix, and drove for Auto Union from 1935. A morphine addiction wrecked his late 1930s; he rebuilt himself after the war and was killed practising at Bremgarten in 1948.
